prompt: Locked camera, seamless natural portrait animation of exactly the same young adult woman in the reference image. Preserve her exact face, short black bob haircut, black long-sleeved sweater, body proportions and lighting. Her inner eyebrows lift slightly, eyes soften and turn downcast, lips form a subtle sad expression, then she slowly returns her gaze to the camera. No tears. Natural breathing, lifelike eyes. Waist-up framing. Hands remain down unless this is the hair-tucking or waving action. Return completely to the exact original neutral facial expression, head angle and resting posture before the final frame. Keep the flat bright green chroma-key background completely unchanged. No talking, no camera movement, no cuts.
negative_prompt: blur, soft focus, loss of facial detail, motion blur, distorted face, identity change, extra fingers, fused fingers, deformed hands, flickering, jitter, camera motion, zoom, text, watermark, background changes
